items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Was that Lou Hooper?' and later confirms 'But it wasn't Lou Hooper'. The interviewee narrates an anecdote about a different pianist and Zutty Monroe, showing no personal interaction or direct relationship with Lou Hooper.

ctx.x: Yeah, and then we got to somebody else, I forget who it was now. And then finally that's where you have a little guy from Canada, the negro, Canada that's playing piano. And there was something happening that I never get, didn't, never did get through laughing. One night he was -
That didn't sound like the name. A little bit tall, dark guy, I forget his name now -
